Remark
[Lie derivative of the metric] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0295 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

The Lie derivative of the metric satisfies \[ (\Lie _X g)(Y,Z)=g( abla _YX,Z)+g(Y, abla _ZX), \] and in local coordinates \[ (\Lie _X g)_{ij}= abla _i X_j+ abla _j X_i. \]
